name: washington_z10
note: BASE frame of the Battle 21 (George Washington) worlds: web mercator zoom 10, origin = world px of ~(41.3 N, 75.7 W) rounded to 16 (NW of the Delaware valley / New York harbour). Map units: x east, y south; 1 base unit = 1 z10 pixel (~114.5 m at Trenton, ~112.9 m at Brooklyn). A region with zoom z uses base units x 2^(z-10) (colonies z9 = /2, brooklyn/trenton/princeton z11 = x2, crossing z12 = x4). engine_mpu = the metres-per-unit the engine assumes (GM3D_GEO.mpu; the Vicksburg value, so smoke / clouds / troops keep their approved size in map units); the baker rescales each region's exag so its relief stays true to the real metres per unit.
